input.intent: Restore the EXACT eight approved description strings specified by JSON-pointer in context.approvedDescriptionsToRestore into the current same-campaign candidate. These strings were independently source/runtime reviewed and accidentally shortened by the preceding price refinement. Do not summarize, truncate, paraphrase or omit these strings. Preserve EVERY other field exactly, especially the corrected Crew Cook tier prices125/200/400/700/1400, base850, mechanics, forms, attacks, resources and other descriptions. Return the COMPLETE valid executable unit, not a patch. This is an exact prose restoration, with no other design changes. candidateToRefine.name: Sanji — Black Leg
candidateToRefine.description: Straw Hat cook and kick specialist, adapted from One Piece manga through Wano. All damage, distances, prices, burn durations, stamina limits and tier unlocks are provisional game tuning, not canon measurements or established end-Wano exhaustion limits. Highest purchased tier on any path unlocks the shared forms and Techniques. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique in the current form supplies the single Technique button; lower-tier Techniques do not retain separate permanent buttons. Purchases are cumulative; at most two paths may be purchased, with the smaller at most tier 2, yielding a maximum 5-2-0. Sanji remains stationary and attacks only with kicks; hand-supported acrobatics do not become punches. Diable Jambe and Ifrit Jambe replace his primary rather than adding attacks. Burns implement lingering ignition, not ranged fire. Sky Walk informs Spectre's overhead stomps, but actual flight, free travel, evasion and carrying are omitted, not simulated by reach. Blue Walk, infiltration, rescue movement, Parage Shoot facial reconstruction, defensive Haki, exoskeleton durability and accelerated self-recovery are omitted. There is no tower HP, shield or defensive combat. Chivalry remains a source trait without invented gender filtering. The destroyed Raid Suit is unavailable; neither optical invisibility nor speed-based concealment is granted. Cooking support is a disclosed nearby meal-service abstraction, not canonical remote wound repair or an ally damage buff. Caller supplies enemy motion, eligibility and ally injuries; this contract does not simulate path following or establish balance.

techniques.name: Poêle à Frire: Spectre — Stationary Combination

paths.name: Kicking Power
paths.description: Personal impact and armor pressure grounded in Black Leg strength and Armament reinforcement. Armor ignore is a bounded game interpretation, not advanced internal-destruction Haki.

upgrades.name: Zeff's Kick Training
upgrades.description: Adds 6 damage to primary contacts and every hit of all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Kicks
upgrades.description: Ignores 15% of armor on ordinary contact damage.

upgrades.name: Heavy Impact
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and Technique contact damage by 1.25.

upgrades.name: Awakened Kicking Strength
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and Technique contact damage by another 1.4.

paths.name: Speed and Observation
paths.description: Fast kicks, acrobatic contact coverage and presence sensing.

upgrades.name: Rapid Footwork
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and recovery timing by 0.9; Technique timing is unchanged.

upgrades.name: Observation Haki
upgrades.description: Enables concealed-target detection without wall penetration, future sight or invulnerability bypass.

upgrades.name: Acrobatic Kick Coverage
upgrades.description: Adds 4 reach to the active contact profile, including its contextual Techniques.

upgrades.name: Responsive Target Selection
upgrades.description: Allows one eligible replacement when the primary target is lost at contact resolution. Techniques remain locked.

paths.name: Crew Cook
paths.description: Periodic nearby meal service adapts Sanji's cooking and restorative cuisine into ally healing. This is not evidence of remote medicine, instant wound closure, resurrection or damage enhancement. Each purchase replaces this path's support configuration, carrying interval progress; the first unlock waits a full interval. Pulses select living injured allies with unobstructed line of sight, lowest health fraction then ID, and never exceed maximum health. Service continues without enemies and during heat modes. The caller must supply injuries; these purchases have conditional value in injured-ally encounters.

upgrades.name: Hot Meal
upgrades.description: Every 8 seconds, heals up to 2 eligible allies within 14 units for 10 each.

upgrades.name: Extra Portions
upgrades.description: Expands meal service to 3 allies within 18 units; keeps 10 healing and the 8-second interval.

upgrades.name: Restorative Soup
upgrades.description: Raises healing to 18 per ally. Injury healing is a game abstraction.

upgrades.name: Rapid Kitchen Service
upgrades.description: Shortens meal interval to 6 seconds while retaining radius 18, cap 3 and healing 18.

upgrades.name: Crew Banquet
upgrades.description: Serves up to 5 eligible allies for 26 healing each every 6 seconds within 18 units. No ally damage buff.

context.independentReview: Five cooking prices correctly changed, but eight descriptions were shortened despite exact-preserve instruction. This erased source/lifecycle boundaries from previously accepted prose. Restore exact supplied strings; never change current correct prices.

approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/0/description: Personal impact and armor pressure grounded in Black Leg strength and Armament reinforcement. Armor ignore is a bounded game interpretation, not advanced internal-destruction Haki. Heat is implemented separately by forms and burn statuses. Ifrit's rapid combination uses one locked target; its finishing launch off Onigashima is omitted rather than applying displacement on every hit. Hell Memories and its enormous engulfing flame are omitted. Burn magnitudes are fixed status values; damage purchases improve contacts, not those authored ticks.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/0/upgrades/1/description: Ignores 15% of armor on ordinary contact damage. Reaching tier 2 also unlocks stamina and Diable Jambe, regardless of path. The single Technique button offers Mouton Shot in Black Leg or Flambage Shot in Diable Jambe until a higher-tier contextual Technique replaces it.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/0/upgrades/3/description: Raises purchased armor ignore to 35%. Highest tier 4 replaces Mouton Shot with Anti-Manner Kick Course on Black Leg's contextual Technique button, and Flambage Shot with Spectre on Diable Jambe's. Lower-tier Techniques retain no separate buttons.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/0/upgrades/4/description: Multiplies primary and Technique contact damage by another 1.4. Highest tier 5 unlocks Ifrit Jambe; this purchase grants no exoskeleton defense or healing.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/1/description: Fast kicks, acrobatic contact coverage and presence sensing. Detection only addresses concealment; obstacles and invulnerability remain separate checks. Retargeting replaces one lost primary target at resolution without restarting windup and never redirects Techniques. Reach stays within ordinary close-contact scale; it is not Sky Walk locomotion. Spectre compresses its airborne repeated stomps into four locked-target contacts without flight or collateral. Anti-Manner's displacement is a bounded impact interpretation, requires displaceable and cannot pass the path entrance.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/1/upgrades/2/description: Adds 4 reach to the active contact profile, including its contextual Techniques; base reach becomes 16.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/1/upgrades/4/description: Multiplies primary timing by another 0.75. Represents faster kicks only, not invisibility, movement or guaranteed hits.
approvedDescriptionsToRestore./paths/2/upgrades/2/description: Raises healing to 18 per ally. Inspired by soup restoring energy and strength, with injury healing explicitly a game abstraction.

knowledge.subject: Sanji
gaps: No fresh external research was performed. This record consolidates only the supplied captures; their linked manga chapters, images and ability subpages were not independently retrieved or verified.

All three supplied captures were read through their ends, including references and navigation. All are marked acquisitionTruncated=false. Complete captures do not establish completeness of the character's technique repertoire, and navigation links are not evidence that their listed abilities belong to Sanji.

The abilities page mixes manga, anime, supplementary publications and later story material. Selection follows the requested manga-through-Wano continuity, rather than adopting every current statement on that page. The general character profile is not itself a cutoff-specific manga record.
The Wano summary is an arc page, not a Sanji ability source. It supplies context for the crew's departure but does not independently verify Ifrit Jambe or the Raid Suit's destruction.

Excluded post-cutoff material includes Egghead feats involving S-Shark, Kizaru and Nusjuro, sensing Bonney in a warm eddy, later Lady Radar naming and smell examples, and the page's later Supreme King Haki discussion. No supplied pre-cutoff evidence establishes Sanji using Supreme King Haki.

The current bounty of 1,032,000,000 is attributed by the abilities page to Chapter 1058, explicitly described there as post-Wano. It is not selected as an endpoint statistic merely because the current character profile displays it.

The character profile summarizes Sanji as never using his hands in combat, whereas the detailed abilities page describes hand-supported acrobatics, incidental weapons and the food-specific knife exception. These are retained as qualifications to the no-punch, hands-for-cooking principle.

The profile describes fiery legs in terms of speed and friction, while the abilities page also reports passion-based explanations and Queen's genetic speculation. The supplied evidence does not resolve a single comprehensive biological mechanism for Diable Jambe.

The supplied page links dedicated Black Leg Style, Diable Jambe and Ifrit Jambe pages, but their contents were not supplied. The named techniques recorded here are limited to those actually described in the captures; the individual names and mechanics of the Wano Ifrit finishing combination are not provided.

No supported numerical heat temperatures, universal burn duration, damage coefficients, cooldowns, activation costs, bounded mode durations or end-Wano maximum use counts are supplied. 'Short powerful heat modes' would be a game interpretation, not an established source limitation.

Attack Cuisine supports bodily strengthening and restoration of energy and strength, but does not establish immediate wound closure, remote delivery, an ally-healing radius or a quantified injury-repair system.

The embedded request for three five-purchase paths, a 5-2-0 limit, executable upgrades, prices, resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses and a shared technique lifecycle is game guidance rather than character evidence. No Manga Mayhem runtime contract was supplied, and no game implementation or numerical tuning is included in this evidence record.

Stationary targeting cannot fully represent Sky Walk's travel, aerial evasion and carrying, Blue Walk's underwater movement, infiltration or rescue actions. A later adaptation should explicitly identify any such omissions rather than treating a range bonus as complete implementation.

Exoskeleton durability, accelerated self-recovery, defensive Haki, chivalry, cooking expertise and facial reconstruction are retained as character evidence without invented tower HP, shields, taunt, arbitrary gender targeting or substitute stat bonuses. Their runtime representation remains unspecified.
Neither an air-only target class nor independent ranged fire projectiles is established by these captures. Flame-enhanced kicks and aerial movement should not be silently converted into those powers.
No unsupported memory-based claims or caller-invented concepts were added.

gaps: This is a bounded review of supplied passages, not independent verification of linked manga chapters or dedicated technique pages. Later-story material in mixed passages was not used.

The actual candidate omits technique delivery fields and the heated techniques' onHit arrays present in the contextual candidateToRefine. Primary burn statuses do not automatically establish technique burns. Exact preservation of every non-description field therefore has not been achieved, independently of the source-fidelity findings.

The supplied rules explain additive reach but do not explicitly document how techniques with no reach field inherit the active primary contact profile. The claim that the reach purchase also extends every contextual technique requires runtime mapping confirmation.
Stamina is accepted only as disclosed exertion bookkeeping. The passages do not establish the authored end-Wano drain rates, maximum durations or replenishment schedule as source-world physiology.
Cooking recovery is accepted as the expressly disclosed meal-service abstraction, not evidence that Sanji canonically repairs arbitrary injuries at a distance.

Flight, underwater movement, rescue travel, facial reconstruction, defensive Haki, exoskeleton defense and self-healing are not implemented. Chivalry likewise remains descriptive rather than executable.
